title: Aoi's cream edge, second try
question: Which of these, if any, should replace Aoi's portrait in the game?

media.caption: Every attempt in order, at game size on the dark colour; 0 is the portrait in the game now (the one from before aoi-edge-1, put back after "oh no this looks very bad, very distorted and ugly").
In the game now, 1366x860: the cream band on her left (image right).

options.label: aoi-edge-2 recut
options.note: No model: the cut-out trimmed inward past the cream band (smoothed 2 px) and a 3 px dark outline drawn on the new edge. Her silhouette gets thinner on her left (image right), and the top of the collar on that side is cut away. Red rim 4.7% (warn); the flagged pixels are her pink hair meeting the outline and the pink cuff stripes, not a red line. Face drift ccip 0.002 (pass). Pictures: close-ups at 100% beside the original on the dark colour, the game file, the game at 1366x860 and at 390x844.

options.label: aoi-edge-2 inp-d50-s1
options.note: RDBT redraws only the band at denoise 0.5, on the render's own light grey background. The model paints the light rim back. Seed 1, denoise 0.5, euler_ancestral normal, 30 steps, CFG 5, DifferentialDiffusion, full 960x1216 canvas, mask = band grown 3 px minus the outer outline, 2 px blur; pasted back through it.
